purpose: Test a higher-density session-transition breakout family using the public London opening-range convention, preserving the 17Y completed-close clue without changing its failed supply gate.

source_basis.source: MQL5 Opening Range Breakouts MT5 session mapping
source_basis.logic: Published session table defines London Opening Range as 07:00-08:00 GMT, preceding/corresponding to London session 08:00-17:00 GMT.

source_basis.source: MQL5 Session Opening Range Breakout EA
source_basis.logic: Public CodeBase EA records the first N minutes around a chosen session open and opens one position on a confirmed close beyond the locked range.
Open-source strategy locks a pre-session range then trades the first clean close beyond it during a defined London trade window.

frozen_common.range_price: P75 Bid high/low formed only from ticks in completed 07:00-08:00 UTC interval
frozen_common.ownership: one accepted source trade per UTC day maximum; first chronological side wins; no rearm
frozen_common.spread_gate: <=25 P75 points at executable entry tick
frozen_common.lifecycle: 0.01 lot; $0.30 stop; +$0.10 trail activation; $0.03 trail distance; 30s max hold; $0.02 round-trip commission

configs.C01_FIRST_STRICT_TICK: First P75 Bid tick strictly outside locked opening range.
configs.C02_FIRST_COMPLETED_S5_CLOSE: First completed causal S5 close outside range; execute first tick at/after edge if still outside.
configs.C03_FIRST_COMPLETED_S15_CLOSE: First completed causal S15 close outside range; execute first tick at/after edge if still outside.

selection_rule: Advance only a config passing all frozen supply/economic gates; prefer direct net, official wins, then activity. No rescue tuning.
